scope: The First Wake plus ten additional book introductions. Original English narrated SHF previews; local Piper, no audible playback.

independentEditorialReview.scope: Independent sampled source-grounded editorial review. Read every spoken sentence in all seven scripts, with emphasis on hooks, closings, distinctive claims, technical qualifiers and genre. Consulted selected source openings, conclusions, technical exemplars and potentially problematic passages. Not a complete source reread, bibliography audit or listening review.

findings.issue: The scene cites only source-6 THE LOWER ARCHIVE, and its claim ledger quotes the archive opening. The actual birth-deferral and administrative-mercy support is in source-5 THE CHAMBER OF MEASURE.
evidence: Source-5: The Chamber of Measure did not forbid births; it placed them in the future.

findings.recommendedAction: Correct source reference and exact supporting span; narration is supported and does not need rewriting or new audio.
findings.resolution: Verified the-future-column now references source-5 THE CHAMBER OF MEASURE and quotes matching substantive text, including birth deferral and mercy entered as measurement error.

editorialAssessment.bookIntroductionPurpose: Pass in the reviewed scripts: each establishes why this book exists, supplies substantive examples, returns to reader value, and offers a specific starting point.
editorialAssessment.fictionSpoilers: No material ending, reversal, death, perpetrator or late-discovery disclosure found in Those Who No Longer Run; references to generational scale are broad book-journey information.
editorialAssessment.genreFit: Wendigo correctly identifies itself as a philosophical systems argument rather than supernatural horror. Other six films match their books’ fiction, philosophical, research or investment-doctrine purposes.
editorialAssessment.technicalQualifiers: Research proposals remain candidates; proof is distinguished from source fidelity or empirical applicability; finite search does not imply universal safety; the eight-bit wraparound example states its arithmetic convention.
editorialAssessment.financialPromises: Investing film expressly presents a thesis and unresolved wager, with no promised returns or asserted established superiority.
editorialAssessment.sourceCautions: Wendigo retains limits on cultural and biological analogies; Holding preserves legitimate cooperation rather than claiming universal deception; Outfinitism preserves useful mathematics and revisability.
editorialAssessment.remainingBooks: No material issues found in The Frontier Is Correction, Outfinitism, Investing in an AI-Dominated Economy, Outfinite Mathematics, or Holding the Dirty Thing by the Clean Side within this scope.

resolutionVerification.scope: Rechecked only the two reported provenance defects; no broader editorial rereview.
